notes.title: [Enter the Dragon confirmed!]Live Event Preview
notes.content:
"Enter the Dragon" live broadcast is about to start!

Hello, CT City residents! 《CT City》 will be participating in Enter the Dragon, an online indie game fair that brings together the best indie game studios and indie games.
We'll be live-streaming our game on April 25th from 07:00-08:00 (UTC +0) and we look forward to meeting you there!


-Links to live stream: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561199203341279]Click Here[/url]

-Live Streaming Time: 
25th April [b]07:00-08:00[/b] (UTC +0)


HuCang Studio

notes.title: Enter the Dragon is Live!
notes.content: Our livestream as part of Enter the Dragon is about to begin! We'll be streaming[b] [成土市的我 CTCity] [/b]for one hour over on the Enter the Dragon Steam event page, and we would love for you to join us. See you there!
